observations: Three photos show a large industrial machine with a white and red frame, multiple rollers, and a control panel with a digital display and analog gauge.
The machine has a sign on top reading 'SEADMAN ENGINEERING AND MACHINERY' and 'SEADMAN ENGINEERING AND MACHINERY' with contact details and images of similar machines.
The machine is outdoors on uneven ground with stones and debris, suggesting it may be stored or used in a workshop or yard.
There are visible gears, belts, and metal shafts, indicating a mechanical system for rolling or processing material.
The control panel includes a digital readout and a pressure gauge, suggesting it is operational and has adjustable settings.
The machine appears to be a flexographic or rotary printing press for plastic films, commonly used for printing on nylon or poly bags.
No visible damage or wear is obvious from the photos, but the outdoor setting raises concerns about exposure to weather and rust.
